subject: Orchardly pilot demo — shifting timeline due to roadmap sprint
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@orchardly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchardly pilot demo — proposed agenda and times

Hi Alex —

Following up from our discovery call last week, attaching a short deck that outlines a 45-60 minute demo we typically run for engineering and product leads. Proposed agenda:

- 10m: quick business context and success criteria
- 20m: live inference demo (latency/cost walkthrough)
- 10m: deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private)
- 15m: next steps & mutual action plan

We have availability next week on Wed/Thu morning PST. If those won't work, send a couple windows and I can coordinate with product engineering.

Attaching: orchardly-demo-deck-v2.pdf (slide highlights + config examples).

Thanks — happy to tailor the demo to focus more on cost controls / routing if that's higher priority.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@orchardly.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@orchardly.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchardly pilot demo — proposed agenda and times

Jonas —

Thanks for the deck and the clear agenda. We had an all-hands planning sync this morning and the product org has reallocated the Q3 sprint to the payments gateway rewrite. The engineers we planned to involve in the inference pilot are being pulled onto that work immediately, and several leads are traveling for vendor onboarding next week.

Short version: we need to pause demo scheduling for now and move this to backlog. I expect we can revisit timelines in early October once the gateway sprint stabilizes. Can you hold off on booking anything until we confirm?

We still want to keep Redwood in the picture — the priority shift is internal resource constraints, not a change in interest. If you have an abbreviated technical brief or a short recorded walkthrough we can share with the team, that would be helpful to keep momentum.

Apologies for the change; I’ll loop back with a proposed time in Q4.

Best,
Alex
Alex Kim
Head of Platform Engineering, Orchardly
alex.kim@orchardly.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@orchardly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchardly pilot demo — proposed agenda and times

Alex — thanks for the update and totally understand the sprint squeeze. We’ll mark the deal as paused in our tracker (ORC-4321) and set a tentative revisit for the week of Oct 4.

In the meantime:
- I’ve attached a one-page technical brief and a 12-minute recorded demo we can drop into your internal docs. If you want, we can also prepare a 20-minute asynchronous walkthrough tailored to the gateway use case.
- We’ll keep your account on the Q4 nurture list and will not consume any AE/demo slots until you give the green light.

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can propose a lightweight nurture cadence — quick check-ins once/month and a readiness checklist so you can pick up the pilot with minimal ramp when resources free up.

Attached: calendar-snap.png (sample slots we had held).

Appreciate you flagging this early — let us know if a short tech brief is preferred over the recording.

—Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@orchardly.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchardly pilot demo — proposed agenda and times

Alex — understood and thank you for the clarity. Quick plan from our side:

- We’ll move ORC-4321 to a paused status in the pipeline and add an internal note: "Resources redirected to payments rewrite — revisit Oct 2027."
- I’ll schedule a 15-min check-in for the first week of October to confirm feasibility and see if you want an asynchronous walkthrough in the interim.
- Dev, can you draft a one-page readiness checklist (infrastructure + SSO/KMS questions) we can share with Orchardly?

Alex — if priorities shift earlier, shoot me a quick note and we’ll re-open calendar options. Appreciate you keeping us posted.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
